fields.name: ACTOR_SLOT_1_FLAGS
fields.contract: terrain collision updates bits 0 and 6; player collision consumes bit 4

fields.name: ACTOR_SLOT_1_STATE_FLAGS
fields.contract: terrain collision clears bit 4; renderer tests bit 5

fields.name: ACTOR_SLOT_1_FACING_X_FLIP
fields.contract: actor collision tests orientation and scene initialization publishes its initial value

fields.name: ACTOR_SLOT_1_FRAME_PTR
fields.contract: renderer and collision/terrain passes consume the actor frame-record pointer

fields.name: ACTOR_SLOT_1_ANIMATION_PC
fields.contract: scene and level initialization install ROM animation roots for slot 1
